passing.name: finite signed literals include dimensional zero
passing.body: export function Fixture() { return <div style={{ gap: 0, marginTop: -2, width: +12, opacity: 0.5, columnCount: 2 }} />; }

passing.name: dynamic signed length retains runtime helper validation
passing.body: export function Fixture({ length }: { length: number }) { return <div style={{ marginTop: -length }} />; }

passing.name: mixed admitted values remain an explicit length expression
passing.body: export function Fixture({ width }: { width: string | number | undefined }) { return <div style={{ width: width }} />; }

passing.name: alias CSSProperties cast is removed after contextual checks
passing.body: import type { CSSProperties as Style } from 'react'; export function Fixture() { return <div style={{ width: 12 } as Style} />; }

passing.name: string undefined and custom declarations preserve their values
passing.body: export function Fixture() { return <div style={{ color: 'red', width: undefined, '--cue-count': 2 }} />; }

passing.name: retained CSSProperties alias remains imported
passing.body: import type { CSSProperties as Style } from 'react'; export const retained: Style = { width: '1px' }; export function Fixture() { return <div style={{ width: 12 } as Style} />; }
